The '''Senate District'''. also called the '''Legislative District''', '''Government District''' or '''Government Center''', was the central [[Politics/Legends|government]] district in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and was located on its equator

The Senate District bordered the [[Financial District (Coruscant)/Legends|Financial]] and [[Quadrant H-46|Sah'c Districts]], and was in close proximity to the industrial district known as [[The Works/Legends|The Works]]. Many of the buildings in the upper levels of the district were built using the [[New Architecture]] style. At its heart was the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] that contained the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] which was the center of various galactic governments since [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]].

When the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] terraformed [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] into Yuuzhan'tar, it became known as the [[Sacred Precinct]].

Following that war, the [[Reconstruction Authority]] aided in the area's restoration.
